text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review paper that fails the core inclusion criteria. Its primary focus is on modeling soil organic carbon (SOC) dynamics under climate change scenarios, with compost amendment as a management intervention. While it uses spatially explicit modeling at the national scale (Italy) and compares multiple future climate scenarios, its central research question is not Land Use Land Cover (LULC) prediction. The land use classes are static inputs derived from an existing database (Corine Land Cover), and the paper does not simulate or predict changes in LULC over time. The outputs are maps of SOC change, not LULC projections.)
